info.name: Amanah Auth API
info.description:
REST API autentikasi: Login Email, Login WhatsApp + OTP, Register, Lupa Password + OTP.

**Format response**
- Sukses: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`
- Error:  `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {...} } }`

response.name: Akun dibuat
Email dan/atau nomor WhatsApp sudah terdaftar
Validasi gagal. `details` berisi pesan per field.

request.description: Selalu 200 walau nomor belum terdaftar (anti user-enumeration). Cooldown kirim-ulang 60 dtk, maks 5 OTP/jam.
